visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a shaded baseball dugout, a tall Western man wearing a dark blue #53 'Brothers' jersey and white baseball pants stands on concrete steps. He looks down at a young Asian man in a team jersey and cap who is sitting on a bench holding a bat. The background shows a sunny baseball field and grandstand seating. (2) The scene shifts to the open baseball field under bright natural daylight. The Western player (#53) is on the green grass, performing a pitching motion without a batter present. He wears a brown leather glove and throws a ball off-camera. After the pitch, he smiles and waves his hand toward the catcher in a friendly, apologetic gesture. (3) An Asian player in a pink cap and dark blue jersey stands on the field, catching a ball and looking towards the camera with a surprised and impressed facial expression. (4) A close-up interview shot of the young Asian player from the first phase. He wears a yellow-trimmed cap with sunglasses perched on top. He speaks directly to an off-screen interviewer, smiling broadly and gesturing with his hands as he recounts a humorous interaction with his coach.
